route.target: Direct pinned sk executable, no target wrapper.
route.input: Owned workspace contains items.txt; Skim receives SKIM_DEFAULT_COMMAND=python emit.py and reads only these bytes.
route.keyboard: Playtestr sends native inputs to Skim itself in the real PTY.
route.child: One trusted local Python reader and Skim reader shell, bounded by Playtestr process-tree cleanup.
